name: Hoshina Maria
source: Protagonist classmate and a girl with excellent grades. Her true nature is that she is a humorous hybrid and is very mischievous. Once her sister's name is bought up, she will have a 180 degrees image change. Smiling while scolding harshly, these siblings has gained a reputation. She is her sister's childhood playmate so she is proficient in a variety of games.
